<img id="aimg_w5551" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://www.helloimg.com/i/2026/07/20/6a5dd0e420a46.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://www.helloimg.com/i/2026/07/20/6a5dd0e420a46.png"><br>
按照豆包说的方法 按F12 把代码 进去回车就行了<br>
<br>
还让豆包生成了php的代码 我测试也是好使的，前提是 右键属性 复制出来 地址 放在浏览器里面 能正常预览<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[PHP] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: php; gutter: true">&lt;?php
$previewUrl = 'https://x-edu-pdfjs.ykt.eduyun.cn/generic/web/viewer.html?hasCatalog=true&amp;file=https://r3-ndr-private.ykt.cbern.com.cn/edu_product/esp/assets/2e3dc199-9c42-486b-bbee-7731bd0ee227.pkg/%E4%B9%89%E5%8A%A1%E6%95%99%E8%82%B2%E6%95%99%E7%A7%91%E4%B9%A6%20%E8%AF%AD%E6%96%87%20%E5%85%AD%E5%B9%B4%E7%BA%A7%20%E4%B8%8A%E5%86%8C_1756191802185.pdf&amp;headers=%7B%22X-ND-AUTH%22:%22MAC%20id=%5C%227F938B205F876FC3A30551F3A4931383A07DDB1AEBB8190E746C92514B469A6B2F5D26E67DD566C057B36D3668036397A914E21AB7C89DFE%5C%22,nonce=%5C%221784528521404:D4T5CTEO%5C%22,mac=%5C%22d9Q0SVizVnW8xWeIle6C4bzJxGs9XiyrDSNZuAMw0Ps=%5C%22%22%7D';
$urlInfo = parse_url($previewUrl);
parse_str($urlInfo['query'], $queryParams);
$pdfRealUrl = $queryParams['file'];
$headerJson = urldecode($queryParams['headers']);
$headerArr = json_decode($headerJson, true);
$authHeaderValue = $headerArr['X-ND-AUTH'];

$name=time();
$saveFile = fopen(__DIR__ . "/$name.pdf", 'wb');
$ch = curl_init($pdfRealUrl);
$curlHeaders = ["X-ND-AUTH: {$authHeaderValue}", "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 Chrome"];

curl_setopt_array($ch, [
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     =&gt; $curlHeaders,
    CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION =&gt; true,
    CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        =&gt; 300,
    CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER =&gt; false,
    CURLOPT_FILE           =&gt; $saveFile, // 直接流式写入文件，不占用PHP内存
]);

curl_exec($ch);
$httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
$err = curl_error($ch);
curl_close($ch);
fclose($saveFile);

if ($err) die("下载异常：" . $err);
if ($httpCode !== 200) die("访问拒绝，状态码：{$httpCode}，鉴权已过期");
echo "流式下载完成";
?&gt;</pre></div><br>
